The tier 6 Krenim Annorax Science Dreadnought was originally designed by the Krenim to house a devastating temporal weapon that could alter timelines. This menacing science vessel is incredibly durable, but not very agile. It features a built in Chroniton Lance that can be used to cause devastating damage to enemies as well as render them helpless for a short time.

The Krenim Annorax Science Dreadnought features a Lieutenant Commander Tactical/Intel specialist bridge officer seat and a Lieutenant Universal/Intel specialist bridge officer seat.

The Krenim Annorax Science Dreadnought comes equipped with a single Krenim Heavy Raider hangar pet. These small craft are durable and equipped with Coalition Disruptor Arrays, Coalition Disruptor Dual Beam Banks and Chroniton Torpedoes. Standard Krenim Heavy Raiders can use Surgical Strikes I, Torpedo: High Yield I and Viral Matrix I.

Console - Universal - Temporal Distortion Field

This device allows the Krenim Science Dreadnought to create a local temporal distortion field that causes your starship to partially phase out of time. While in this state your starship gains significantly increased flight speed and turn rate. In addition, the distortion causes the starship to become immune to energy damage, but also deal substantially less energy damage for the duration of the effect. When your starship returns to normal space you will create a temporal disturbance that will cause a moderate amount of Antiproton damage, hold enemies and reduce the rate at which their abilities recharge.

While equipped, this console also passively improves Exotic Damage moderately.

This console mod may only be equipped on the Krenim Science Dreadnought and may be equipped in any of its console slots.

Time to Kill (Starship Trait)

After achieving level 5 in your Krenim Annorax Science Dreadnought [T6], you will unlock the Time to Kill starship trait. While equipped, all of your science bridge officer abilities will boost your damage slightly. This effect can stack up to 3 times.
